papers.title: SoloQ: Calibration-Free Quantization for Diffusion Language Models
papers.summary: Diffusion large language models dLLMs) have emerged as a promising alternative to autoregressive language models through bidirectional diffusion-based token generation. However, their growing model sizes and high inference costs make efficient deployment challenging: full-sequence denoising repeatedly invokes compute-intensive forward passes, while block-diffusion models additionally introduce a memory-intensive KV-cache. Low-bit weight-activation quantization is therefore attractive, yet existing dLLM post-training quantization methods rely on calibration data despite activation distributions shifting across masking states and denoising steps. We present SoloQ, a calibration-free quantization framework that maps weights and activations into a normalized rotated basis with a predictable marginal distribution, enabling data-independent quantization. SoloQ combines a structured K-RPBH rotation with a lightweight rescaling correction for calibration-free quantization. Its predictable post-rotation distribution supports both distribution-matched codebooks and hardware-native NVFP4. For block-diffusion models, SoloQ further applies commit-time KV-cache quantization to compress persistent states without perturbing the actively denoised block. Across full-sequence dLLMs (LLaDA and Dream) and block-diffusion dLLMs(Fast-dLLM v2 and Nemotron-Labs-Diffusion), SoloQ retains accuracy under 4-bit quantization and outperforms calibration-based baselines on knowledge- and reasoning-intensive benchmarks. With NVFP4, SoloQ reduces peak memory by up to 2.61X and accelerates end-to-end inference by up to 2.24X.

localized.title_zh: SoloQ：扩散语言模型的免校准量化
localized.summary_zh: 通过基于双向扩散的标记生成，扩散大语言模型（dLLM）已成为自回归语言模型的有前途的替代方案。然而，它们不断增长的模型大小和高昂的推理成本使得高效部署面临挑战：全序列去噪反复调用计算密集型前向传播，而块扩散模型还引入了内存密集型 KV 缓存。因此，低位权重激活量化很有吸引力，但现有的 dLLM 训练后量化方法依赖于校准数据，尽管激活分布在掩蔽状态和去噪步骤之间发生变化。我们提出了 SoloQ，这是一种免校准量化框架，它将权重和激活映射到具有可预测边缘分布的归一化旋转基础上，从而实现与数据无关的量化。 SoloQ 将结构化 K-RPBH 旋转与轻量级重新缩放校正相结合，实现免校准量化。其可预测的旋转后分布支持分布匹配的码本和硬件本机 NVFP4。对于块扩散模型，SoloQ 进一步应用提交时 KV 缓存量化来压缩持久状态，而不会干扰主动降噪块。在全序列 dLLM（LLaDA 和 Dream）和块扩散 dLLM（Fast-dLLM v2 和 Nemotron-Labs-Diffusion）中，SoloQ 保留了 4 位量化下的准确性，并且在知识和推理密集型基准测试中优于基于校准的基线。借助 NVFP4，SoloQ 将峰值内存减少高达 2.61 倍，并将端到端推理加速高达 2.24 倍。

papers.title: ProgramGym: Scaling Training Environments for Long-Horizon Program Reproduction Agents
papers.summary: Coding agents are increasingly used to build programs from scratch as software engineers do rather than to resolve issues within a repository or to generate a repository from a given requirements document. However, scalable verifiable training environments that force agents to discover what is required and to decide how the system should be designed remain scarce. Moreover, existing agent workflows also cannot sustain long-horizon development in which the agent explores the reference program before implementation. To address these challenges, we introduce ProgramGym, a framework consisting of Program-Env and Program-Agent for scalable training environments of long-horizon program reproduction agents. Specifically, Program-Env constructs verifiable training environments from repositories through a feedback-driven loop that repairs runtime sandbox builds and the quality of black-box tests. Using this novel pipeline, we obtain 1,648 training environments spanning C, C++, Go, and Rust. Program-Agent combines a role-isolated workflow of analysis, implementation, and review with revision management for compilation checks and failure recovery. Experiments on ProgramBench show that both Program-Env and Program-Agent improve performance on program reproduction. Fine-tuning on trajectories with these constructed environments raises the performance of Qwen3.8-27B from 34.87% to 42.84%. Program-Agent further raises the base and SFT models to 55.71% and 56.25%, both exceeding some flagship models. We will release the ProgramGym to support further research on coding agents that build programs from scratch.

localized.title_zh: ProgramGym：为长期程序复制代理扩展训练环境
localized.summary_zh: 编码代理越来越多地用于像软件工程师一样从头开始构建程序，而不是解决存储库中的问题或从给定的需求文档生成存储库。然而，迫使代理发现需求并决定如何设计系统的可扩展、可验证的培训环境仍然很少。此外，现有的代理工作流程也无法维持代理在实施之前探索参考程序的长期开发。为了应对这些挑战，我们引入了 ProgramGym，这是一个由 Program-Env 和 Program-Agent 组成的框架，用于长期程序复制代理的可扩展训练环境。具体来说，Program-Env 通过反馈驱动的循环从存储库构建可验证的训练环境，修复运行时沙箱构建和黑盒测试的质量。使用这个新颖的管道，我们获得了涵盖 C、C++、Go 和 Rust 的 1,648 个训练环境。程序代理将角色隔离的分析、实施和审查工作流程与用于编译检查和故障恢复的修订管理相结合。 ProgramBench上的实验表明，Program-Env和Program-Agent都提高了程序再现的性能。通过这些构建环境对轨迹进行微调，将 Qwen3.8-27B 的性能从 34.87% 提高到 42.84%。 Program-Agent将基础机型和SFT机型进一步提升至55.71%和56.25%，均超过部分旗舰机型。我们将发布 ProgramGym 以支持对从头开始构建程序的编码代理的进一步研究。

papers.title: RSI-Anything: Unlocking Recursive Self-Improvement with World Models
papers.summary: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) aims to transform interaction experience into persistent improvements, yet external feedback is costly and world-model predictions may become unreliable as policies evolve. We introduce RSI-Anything, a domain-general framework built on JEPA-Anything that uses predictive world models to guide action and learning-data selection. Observed feedback drives policy or workflow improvement and conditional world-model adaptation, while component and compatibility checks govern the retention of updated policy-model pairs. Across diverse computational and scientific domains, RSI-Anything demonstrates substantial gains. In code repair, with the coder fixed, success increases from 26.3% with a static verifier to 29.2% through predictive selection and 31.2% after world-model adaptation, at comparable test usage. Graphical user interface (GUI) evaluations showed higher task completion, while average actions decrease by 39.4%. Across five successive policy versions, laboratory-planning scores more than double from 21.80% to 46.01%. In reaction optimization, RSI-Anything achieves 96.15% mean best observed yield versus 82.16% for Bayesian optimization under the same 40-experiment budget. An end-to-end immune-science application further connects workflow evolution and predictive modeling with therapeutic hypothesis generation. These results demonstrate how predictive world models and retained system updates enable recursive improvement across diverse environments.

localized.title_zh: RSI-Anything：用世界模型解锁递归自我改进
localized.summary_zh: 递归自我改进（RSI）旨在将交互体验转化为持续改进，但外部反馈成本高昂，并且随着政策的发展，世界模型预测可能变得不可靠。我们引入 RSI-Anything，这是一个基于 JEPA-Anything 构建的领域通用框架，它使用预测世界模型来指导行动和学习数据选择。观察到的反馈推动策略或工作流程改进以及有条件的世界模型适应，而组件和兼容性检查则控制更新策略模型对的保留。在不同的计算和科学领域，RSI-Anything 展示了巨大的收益。在代码修复中，在编码器固定的情况下，在可比较的测试使用情况下，通过预测选择，成功率从静态验证器的 26.3% 提高到 29.2%，世界模型适应后提高到 31.2%。图形用户界面 (GUI) 评估显示任务完成率更高，而平均操作次数减少了 39.4%。在连续五个政策版本中，实验室规划得分翻了一番多，从 21.80% 增至 46.01%。在反应优化中，RSI-Anything 在相同的 40 次实验预算下实现了 96.15% 的平均最佳观察产率，而贝叶斯优化的平均最佳观察产率为 82.16%。端到端免疫科学应用程序进一步将工作流程演变和预测建模与治疗假设生成联系起来。这些结果展示了预测世界模型和保留的系统更新如何在不同的环境中实现递归改进。

papers.title: PolyOCR-Venus: Unified OCR Foundation Models for Text-Centric Visual Intelligence
papers.summary: Optical Character Recognition (OCR) is evolving from plain-text transcription toward general visual intelligence, requiring models to recognize, localize, and reason over textual information in complex visual environments. However, existing OCR systems often excel at only some tasks and struggle to balance recognition, parsing, and reasoning across scenarios. In this report, we present PolyOCR, a family of unified OCR foundation models of varying scales. PolyOCR combines a shared instruction-following framework with a large-scale data engine that converts heterogeneous visual resources into quality-verified OCR supervision. We introduce Competence-Guided Policy Optimization, which combines verifier-based Group Relative Policy Optimization with on-policy distillation through sample-wise routing based on teacher reliability and the teacher--student competence gap. We also introduce OCRBench v2.1, our revision of OCRBench v2 with manually verified annotation corrections and task-aligned scoring metrics. Extensive experiments across OCRBench v2.1, CC-OCR, in-house KIE Benchmark, OmniDocBench v1.6 and MDPBench demonstrate that PolyOCR achieves state-of-the-art or highly competitive performance.

localized.title_zh: PolyOCR-Venus：用于以文本为中心的视觉智能的统一 OCR 基础模型
localized.summary_zh: 光学字符识别 (OCR) 正在从纯文本转录向通用视觉智能发展，要求模型能够在复杂的视觉环境中识别、定位和推理文本信息。然而，现有的 OCR 系统通常只擅长某些任务，并且难以平衡跨场景的识别、解析和推理。在本报告中，我们介绍了 PolyOCR，这是一系列不同规模的统一 OCR 基础模型。 PolyOCR 将共享指令跟踪框架与大规模数据引擎相结合，将异构视觉资源转换为经过质量验证的 OCR 监督。我们引入了能力引导的策略优化，它将基于验证者的组相对策略优化与通过基于教师可靠性和师生能力差距的样本路由的策略蒸馏相结合。我们还引入了 OCRBench v2.1，这是我们对 OCRBench v2 的修订版，具有手动验证的注释更正和任务对齐的评分指标。 OCRBench v2.1、CC-OCR、内部 KIE Benchmark、OmniDocBench v1.6 和 MDPBench 的大量实验表明，PolyOCR 实现了最先进或极具竞争力的性能。

papers.title: Here the World in Stereo: Learning Dynamic Spatial Correspondence for Immersive Joint Video-Audio Generation
papers.summary: Recent joint video-audio generation models have achieved strong semantic correspondence and temporal synchronization. However, applications such as AR/VR and interactive gaming further require stereo audio to provide an immersive sense, which remains largely overlooked. Effective stereo audio requires the perceived sound location to evolve consistently with the motion of its corresponding visual source. We refer to this property as Dynamic Spatial Correspondence and propose StereoBind, a framework that binds visual source motion to stereo sound generation. StereoBind uses motion tracks to coordinate visual motion and stereo audio through three complementary mechanisms. Visual Motion Binding establishes source-aware audiovisual correspondence, the Spatial Track Encoder captures absolute source positions, and Residual Track RoPE models relative motion. For supervision and evaluation, we construct StereoWorld-29K, a large-scale stereo audio-video dataset with paired motion tracks, and StereoWorldBench for measuring audiovisual spatial consistency. Experiments show that StereoBind substantially improves spatial alignment in stereo audio generation over existing models while preserving overall audiovisual quality.

teaching.evidence: Experiments show that StereoBind substantially improves spatial alignment in stereo audio generation over existing models while preserving overall audiovisual quality.

localized.title_zh: 这里是立体声世界：学习动态空间对应以生成沉浸式联合视频音频
localized.summary_zh: 最近的联合视频-音频生成模型已经实现了强语义对应和时间同步。然而，AR/VR 和互动游戏等应用进一步需要立体声音频来提供身临其境的感觉，而这一点在很大程度上仍然被忽视。有效的立体声音频需要感知的声音位置与其相应视觉源的运动一致地演变。我们将此属性称为动态空间对应，并提出了 StereoBind，这是一个将视觉源运动与立体声生成绑定的框架。 StereoBind 使用运动轨道通过三种互补机制来协调视觉运动和立体声音频。视觉运动绑定建立源感知视听对应，空间跟踪编码器捕获绝对源位置，剩余跟踪 RoPE 模拟相对运动。为了监督和评估，我们构建了 StereoWorld-29K，这是一个具有配对运动轨迹的大型立体声音频视频数据集，以及用于测量视听空间一致性的 StereoWorldBench。实验表明，与现有模型相比，StereoBind 显着改善了立体声音频生成的空间对齐，同时保持了整体视听质量。

papers.title: Towards Physically Grounded Articulated 3D Assets: A Multi-Agent Pipeline and Benchmark
papers.summary: In this paper, we study physically grounded articulated 3D asset generation---moving the goal from reproducing how objects look to capturing how they move and function. Inspired by the literature on procedural and agentic generation, we present Artisan, a system that extends the latest method Articraft by introducing a multi-agent pipeline with physical simulation feedback, enabling comprehensive attributes beyond geometry, appearance, and physically plausible articulation, such as collision-free motion, stability under gravity, and accurate mass and material properties. Furthermore, we construct a unified benchmark spanning four key aspects: spatial fidelity, physical plausibility, downstream task performance, and overall quality. The benchmark encompasses 100 reference assets from ArtVIP and LightWheel, 50 stability prompts, and 50 ABO objects with reference masses, with protocols evaluating various metrics. Through extensive evaluation of more than 10 representative models, Artisan achieves competitive spatial fidelity while attaining the lowest collision rates and highest stability rates among the evaluated methods. Together, our system and benchmark establish insights for advancing 3D generation towards physically plausible, functionally usable assets.

localized.title_zh: 迈向物理接地的铰接 3D 资产：多代理管道和基准
localized.summary_zh: 在本文中，我们研究基于物理的铰接式 3D 资产生成，将目标从再现对象的外观转变为捕获它们的移动和功能方式。受程序和代理生成文献的启发，我们提出了 Artisan，这是一个通过引入具有物理模拟反馈的多代理管道来扩展最新方法 Articraft 的系统，支持几何、外观和物理上合理的关节之外的综合属性，例如无碰撞运动、重力下的稳定性以及精确的质量和材料属性。此外，我们构建了一个涵盖四个关键方面的统一基准：空间保真度、物理合理性、下游任务性能和整体质量。该基准包含来自 ArtVIP 和 LightWheel 的 100 个参考资产、50 个稳定性提示和 50 个具有参考质量的 ABO 对象，以及评估各种指标的协议。通过对 10 多个代表性模型的广泛评估，Artisan 实现了有竞争力的空间保真度，同时在评估方法中实现了最低的碰撞率和最高的稳定性率。我们的系统和基准共同建立了见解，以推动 3D 生成成为物理上合理、功能上可用的资产。

papers.title: EmbodiedCLBench: Evaluating Continual Learning for Self-Evolving Embodied Agents
papers.summary: Continual learning requires models to accumulate past experience and transfer it to new tasks. Despite substantial research on continual learning, existing work remains largely confined to non-embodied settings, without extending to embodied environments. To address this gap, we introduce EmbodiedCLBench, the first benchmark in embodied simulation for evaluating the continual learning capability of self-evolving agents. With compositional generalization as the core evaluation principle, our benchmark evaluates whether agents can first learn from basic tasks and then recombine the acquired skills to solve complex, unseen advanced tasks. Based on EmbodiedCLBench, we conduct extensive experiments across multiple agent harnesses and learning methods, revealing consistent limitations and distinctive behaviors. Our results show that while advanced tasks can be hardly solved under zero-shot setting, the experience from basic tasks enables consistent improvement. Such benefit from the experience remains stable even if the task complexity increases. However, this improvement does not scale accordingly with the number of learning samples, and current agents cannot extract meaningful information from additional experience. Collectively, our findings highlight continual learning as a fundamental yet underexplored capability, and our benchmark offers valuable resources for designing effective self-evolving agents in embodied environments. Our code and dataset are available at https://pku-value-lab.github.io/EmbodiedCLBench-homepage.

localized.title_zh: EmbodiedCLBench：评估自我进化的体现代理的持续学习
localized.summary_zh: 持续学习需要模型积累过去的经验并将其转移到新的任务中。尽管对持续学习进行了大量研究，但现有的工作仍然主要局限于非具身环境，而没有扩展到具身环境。为了解决这一差距，我们引入了 EmbodiedCLBench，这是体现模拟中用于评估自我进化智能体持续学习能力的第一个基准。我们的基准以组合泛化为核心评估原则，评估智能体是否能够首先从基本任务中学习，然后重新组合所获得的技能来解决复杂的、看不见的高级任务。基于 EmbodiedCLBench，我们对多种代理工具和学习方法进行了广泛的实验，揭示了一致的局限性和独特的行为。我们的结果表明，虽然高级任务在零样本设置下很难解决，但基本任务的经验可以持续改进。即使任务复杂性增加，这种经验带来的好处仍然保持稳定。然而，这种改进并不会随着学习样本的数量而相应地扩展，并且当前的代理无法从额外的经验中提取有意义的信息。总的来说，我们的研究结果强调持续学习是一种基本但尚未充分开发的能力，我们的基准为在具体环境中设计有效的自我进化代理提供了宝贵的资源。我们的代码和数据集可在 https://pku-value-lab.github.io/EmbodiedCLBench-homepage 获取。

papers.title: AMLworld-Compact: Importance-Weighted Downsampling for Cost-Effective LLM Evaluation and Error Diagnosis
papers.summary: Evaluating large language models (LLMs) on AMLworld's smallest test splits is costly because each of over a million targets requires a separate graph prompt. Sampling reduces this cost, but small balanced subsets change unweighted precision and F1. We introduce AMLworld-Compact, an evaluation set that retains every illicit test transaction and samples benign transactions from supervised-score strata. Its HT-Coreset protocol reduces evaluation targets by 271x and 611x on HI-Small and LI-Small. Horvitz-Thompson weights give unbiased full-test confusion-count estimates for fixed predictions; recall is exact, while precision and F1 are ratio estimates. In a held-out study using Graph Feature Preprocessor (GFP) features, one boosted-tree family defines strata for evaluating the other over 500 draws per configuration. At the released sizes, F1 RMSE is 0.00-2.58 percentage points versus 4.44-7.41 for uniform sampling with HT weights; conservative intervals remain broad. Under the evaluated graph prompts, seven open-weight LLMs have weighted precision near the predict-all-illicit baseline. In an outcome-stratified audit of 1,000 HI-Small few-shot outputs from one run per model, lexical checks pass for 84.5% of correct and 56.2% of incorrect binary verdicts, so these markers do not establish correctness. We release the evaluation sets, construction code, and audit tools at https://huggingface.co/datasets/typhoon-ai/AMLworldCompactEval and https://github.com/nat-nischw/AMLworld-Compact.

teaching.new_method: We introduce AMLworld-Compact, an evaluation set that retains every illicit test transaction and samples benign transactions from supervised-score strata.

localized.title_zh: AMLworld-Compact：重要性加权下采样，实现经济有效的 LLM 评估和错误诊断
localized.summary_zh: 在 AMLworld 最小的测试分割上评估大语言模型 (LLM) 的成本很高，因为超过一百万个目标中的每一个都需要单独的图形提示。采样降低了这种成本，但小的平衡子集会改变未加权精度和 F1。我们引入了 AMLworld-Compact，这是一个评估集，它保留每笔非法测试交易并从监督分数层中抽取良性交易样本。其 HT-Coreset 协议将 HI-Small 和 LI-Small 上的评估目标降低了 271 倍和 611 倍。 Horvitz-Thompson 权重为固定预测提供无偏的完整测试混淆计数估计；召回率是精确的，而精度和 F1 是比率估计。在一项使用图形特征预处理器 (GFP) 特征的持续研究中，一个提升树族定义了用于评估每个配置超过 500 个绘图的其他层。在已发布的尺寸下，F1 RMSE 为 0.00-2.58 个百分点，而使用 HT 权重的均匀采样为 4.44-7.41 个百分点；保守区间仍然很宽。根据评估的图表提示，七个开放权重法学硕士的加权精度接近预测所有非法基线。在对每个模型一次运行的 1,000 个 HI-Small 几次输出进行结果分层审核中，词法检查通过了 84.5% 的正确二元判断和 56.2% 的错误二元判断，因此这些标记无法确定正确性。我们在 https://huggingface.co/datasets/typhoon-ai/AMLworldCompactEval 和 https://github.com/nat-nischw/AMLworld-Compact 上发布了评估集、构建代码和审计工具。

papers.title: GraphDecisionBench: Benchmarking System One Models on Graph Tasks
papers.summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly explored for graph understanding and decision-making, while System One models such as Jev select directly from supplied options. However, the capabilities of System One models on graph-related tasks remain unclear. We introduce GraphDecide, a model-independent benchmark that combines structural task profiles, matched graph-text input contrasts and heuristic-proposal controls to diagnose graph decision performance. We evaluate Jev and related choice-based models alongside language-model baselines, covering fourteen model-interface configurations. Jev's results illustrate the benchmark's central distinctions: accurate adjacency recognition does not guarantee broader structural correctness, joint graph-text input does not consistently improve prediction, and feasible construction does not establish high solution quality. Its task contracts, candidate interfaces and scoring rules support comparison across native selectors and language-model adapters. Code and aggregate results are available at https://github.com/VictorYXL/JevGraphBench.

localized.title_zh: GraphDecisionBench：图任务上的 System One 模型基准测试
localized.summary_zh: 人们越来越多地探索大语言模型 (LLM) 用于图形理解和决策，而 Jev 等系统一模型直接从提供的选项中进行选择。然而，系统一模型在图相关任务上的能力仍不清楚。我们引入了 GraphDecide，这是一种独立于模型的基准测试，它结合了结构任务配置文件、匹配的图文本输入对比和启发式建议控制来诊断图决策性能。我们评估 Jev 和相关的基于选择的模型以及语言模型基线，涵盖十四种模型界面配置。 Jev 的结果说明了该基准的主要区别：准确的邻接识别并不能保证更广泛的结构正确性，联合图文输入不能始终如一地改善预测，可行的构造不能建立高解决方案质量。它的任务契约、候选界面和评分规则支持跨本机选择器和语言模型适配器的比较。代码和汇总结果可在 https://github.com/VictorYXL/JevGraphBench 获取。

papers.title: Inducing Process Supervision from Outcome-Only Reinforcement Learning
papers.summary: Process reward models (PRMs) have become a key component for LLMs, as their step-level feedback supports both post-training and test-time reasoning. However, training strong PRMs remains costly: human step annotation is difficult to scale, while Monte Carlo estimation is computationally expensive and can drift from the intrinsic correctness of steps. To get effective PRMs at low cost, we introduce TIPS (Thinking-Induced Process Supervision), an outcome-only reinforcement learning (RL) framework for training generative PRMs. In TIPS, the model generates a chain-of-thought (CoT) followed by step-level labels and an outcome label. The reward depends solely on whether the predicted outcome matches the ground truth, and the resulting group-relative advantage is used to optimize the entire generated response. Intuitively, when checking intermediate steps helps determine the outcome, more accurate checks can lead to better outcome judgments and higher rewards. Outcome-only RL can therefore reinforce step-level verification without explicit process supervision. We validate the effectiveness of TIPS across math and agent benchmarks and four backbone families. Notably, TIPS-Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507 reaches 85.2 F1 on ProcessBench with only 3.2K outcome-labeled trajectories, surpassing all evaluated trained PRMs and strong prompt-only judges such as GPT-5.4-Instruct and Claude-4.7-Opus, while still trailing o1-mini. Code and data are available at https://github.com/RUCBM/TIPS.

viewpoints.title: Dwarf Fortress uses version control now
viewpoints.summary: I remember hearing a while ago that Dwarf Fortress didn't use version control. That fact has been lodged in my head, because given its inherent complexity I have trouble imagining a codebase that would benefit from version control more . That's art. I went looking and I'm sad to report that the days without version control appear to have ended. Quoting Tarn Adams over time: March 2013: "I don't use version control -- I didn't like the feeling of having the code get committed into a black box thingy with no immediate upside" March 2016: "I don’t even use version control.
